old: And we long for your praise, like the eager ones: Ahi Budhnya, Aja Ekapād, and Trita, Ṛbhukṣan, Savitṛ has taken delight; the offspring of the waters, of swift impulse, with thought in the work.

old: 'budhnyo3' is printed with a pluti sign (vocative/calling length). 'canaḥ dadhe' (to take delight) is the drafter's reading; 'tritaḥ ṛbhukṣāḥ savitā canaḥ dadhe' may take a different grouping of subjects. 'apām napāt' rendered as 'offspring of the waters'; 'śami' uncertain ('work, effort').
